headline: Public hearing and decision on a dimensional variance for a 288 square foot shed at 45 Oakdale Avenue.
summary: The meeting covers a request by Edward R Laplume for a dimensional variance at 45 Oakdale Avenue. The applicant proposes a 288 square foot shed where a 150 square foot is allowed.
items: Public hearing and decision on a dimensional variance request by Edward R Laplume, applicant and owner
Property at 45 Oakdale Avenue, Tax Assessors Plat 48 Lot 635, in an RT Residential Two Family Zone
Request under Section 410-46 and Section 410.12.2(C) of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance
Proposed 288 square foot shed where a 150 square foot is allowed
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860
plain_text:
City of Pawtucket
Board of Appeals
Meeting Agenda
Monday, October 26, 2026 at 6:45 P.M.
Pawtucket Municipal Annex
100 Freight Street
Pawtucket, RI 02860
Zoning Board of Appeals.
Edward R Laplume applicant and
 
owner of the property at 45 Oakdale Avenue further
identified as Tax Assessors Plat 48 Lot 635 located in an “RT” Residential Two Family
Zone is requesting a Dimensional Variance under Section 410-46 and Section
410.12.2(C) of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance. The applicant is proposing to place a
288 square foot shed on the property where a 150 square foot is allowed.  - FOR PUBLIC
HEARING AND FOR DECISION.
                                                       Nathan T. Luciano
                                                       Chairperson
                                                       Board of Appeals
The Pawtucket Municipal Annex is accessible to people with disabilities. Individuals requesting
services of an interpreter for the hearing impaired must notify the City Clerk at 728-0500 (TDD
#722-8239) 72 hours before the meeting date.
